title: Cabin Window Pane and Reveal — Removal

ata.title: Passenger Compartment Windows — Cabin Window Assembly

abstract: Removal of a cabin window pane and its reveal from the sidewall, including the drain path check and the frame variant identification that decides which reveal and clamp set is refitted.

sections.purpose: To remove a cabin window pane and its reveal from the sidewall for replacement, for cleaning of the drain path or for inspection of the frame lower flange.
sections.job_setup_note: The cabin must be out of service and the row cleared. The frame variant must be identified before the reveal is removed, because three variants are in service and the reveal, the clamps and the drain tube differ between them. A working platform is not required but the seat row must be moved or covered. Two persons are needed.
sections.procedure: Make sure that the cabin is out of service and that the row at the affected window is clear. Remove the sidewall trim panel adjacent to the window and support it clear. Identify the frame variant from the marking on the frame lower flange and record it. CAUTION: THREE FRAME VARIANTS ARE IN SERVICE AND THE REVEAL, THE CLAMP SET AND THE DRAIN TUBE ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE BETWEEN THEM. DO NOT ORDER A REPLACEMENT BEFORE THE VARIANT IS CONFIRMED. Remove the countersunk screws LN741597K8 from the reveal, working from the bottom upwards. Release the reveal from the frame and lower it clear. Disconnect the drain tube at the reveal and cap it. Remove the loop clamps LN143799-12 that secure the drain tube run. Examine the drain path for blockage by flushing it with clean water and confirming that it discharges at the bilge. Record whether the path was clear. WARNING: DO NOT USE COMPRESSED AIR TO CLEAR A BLOCKED DRAIN TUBE. THE TUBE CAN SEPARATE INSIDE THE SIDEWALL AND THE WATER WILL THEN DISCHARGE ONTO THE STRUCTURE. Examine the frame lower flange for staining, for corrosion product and for lifting of the protective finish, and record the condition. Remove the edging grommet AGS159290-6D at the tube pass-through if it is damaged. Support the pane and remove it from the frame land.
sections.close_out: Cover the window aperture with the protective blank. Make sure that the drain tube is capped and secured and that no water remains in the sidewall. Keep the removed reveal and clamp set with the aircraft and label them with the frame variant. Refit or support the sidewall trim panel. Record the removal, the frame variant, the drain path condition and the frame lower flange condition.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Three frame variants are in service until MOD-111982 is embodied.

safety_precautions: Do not use compressed air to clear a blocked drain tube.
Make sure that the cabin is out of service and the row cleared.
Support the sidewall trim panel clear before working at the reveal.
